command_line:
set -eu
{
  echo '--- metaseq file ---'
  python2 - <<'PY' 2>&1 || true
import metaseq, os
print(os.path.dirname(metaseq.__file__))
PY
  echo '--- find integration/chipseq ---'
  find / -type f \( -path '*integration/chipseq.py' -o -path '*integration*chipseq*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -100
  echo '--- find integration dirs ---'
  find / -type d -name integration 2>/dev/null | head -100
  echo '--- list metaseq dir ---'
  python2 - <<'PY' 2>&1 || true
import metaseq, os
p=os.path.dirname(metaseq.__file__)
print(p)
for root,dirs,files in os.walk(p):
    print(root, dirs[:20], files[:20])
PY
} > find_integration.txt
